column2: •  Have your study area in square metres (Workshop Step 1) and your strata areas if you stratified (Step 2).
•  Decide your margin of error and confidence level before you look at any numbers, not after.
•  Plot size defaults to 100 m² (a 10 × 10 m plot per core), matching the workshop. Change it on each sheet if yours differs.
•  The priors in sheet 3 are regional averages. They understate local patchiness — round the SD up.
